hypothesis: Frozen v30 isotonic-4 signals may concentrate expectancy in a realized-vol regime: an on/off regime GATE (keep signal only if its causal trailing-30d realized vol falls in the branch band) crossed with {1x, dd_guard} sizing. This is NOT v03 vol_target sizing (continuous leverage scaling, DEAD per ledger); it is a binary regime filter never tried on this book. Signals/scores untouched; vol uses only candles strictly before signal_time. Exploratory only.
vol_definition: trailing-30-calendar-day std of 5m close log-returns strictly before signal_time (1-microsecond cutoff), annualized x sqrt(365.2425*288); computed with a .loc mask (replaces deprecated .last(), behavior identical); min 100 bars else NaN (excluded from gated bands, kept in control)
band_key: control keeps all signals; low keeps vol_ann < 0.30; mid keeps 0.30 <= vol_ann <= 0.60; high keeps vol_ann > 0.60; vol_ann is causal past-only
dd_guard_reference: ungated-control (control_1x) base-1x sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; regime-gated signals reuse the control-run guard state at their own signal times (same disclosed method as risk_overlay/side_ddguard/session probes)

control_reproduction.action_on_mismatch: STOP, do not proceed to gated branches
